paite: Pathian aw, hon hondam in; tuite lah ka hinna pha in alutta hi.
heading: David La / Panpih Dia Ngetna

paite: Buannawi thukpi, siksan himhim omlouhna ah, ka tum hulhul hi; tui thukpi tui lian hon tupnate ah, ka na lutta hi.
Ka kikouna lam in ka bah a; ka dang akeu khinta; ka Pathian ka ngakna ah ka mit avai khinta hi.
Bangmah lou a hon hote ka samzang sang in atam ua, dikloupi a hon dou a hon hihmanthat tumte mihattak ahi uhi; ka lak het louh ka pe nawn hi.
Pathian aw, nang ka haidan na thei; nang lak ah ka khelhnate sel ahi kei hi.
Toupa aw, sepaihte' PATHIAN, nangmah ngakte keimah ziak in zahlak kei uhen; Israel' Pathian aw, nangmah zongte keimah ziak in hihzum in om kei uhen.
Nangmah ziak a gensiat ka thuak ziak in, zumna in ka mai akhuh khinta hi.
Ka unaute lak ah mikhual ka na hita a, ka nu naute lak ah theih ngei louh mi ka na hita hi.
Na inn a ka phatuamngaihna in hon negai a; nangmah gensete gensiatnate ka tung ah akibung hi.
Ka kah a, an ngawl kawm a ka hinna ka sawileh, huai gensiat a ka omna phet ahi.
Ka puansilh a sai-ip ka zatleh, amaute a dia hoih lou lam a gentehna ka na hi zel.
Kulh kong a tute'n ka tungthu agen ua; zukhamhatte lasak ka hita hi.
Himahleh, TOUPA aw, ke'n zaw, hun kipahhuai ah ahi ka thum; Pathian aw, na zahngaihna thupi ziak in na hotdamna thupitak in hon dawng in.
Buannawi a kipan hon humbit inla, hon tumsak mahmah ke'n; hon hote lak ah leh tui thukpi a kipan humbit in hon omsak in.
Tui lian in hon tummang kei henla, tui thukpi in leng hon valh kei hen, kokhuk in leng akam chihkhum kei hen.
TOUPA aw, hon dawng in; na zahngaihna ahoih ngal a; na zahngaihna thupidan bang zel in kei lam hong nga in.
Na sikha lak ah na mai sel ke'n; ka mangbang ngal a; hon dawng meng in.
Ka hinna hon naih in, tan inla; hon doute ziak in hon humbit in.
Nang mi hon gensiatnate, ka zahlaknate, ka zumnate na thei hi; hon doute na ma ah a-om vek uhi.
Mi hon gensiatna in ka khasia a; nakpitak in ka lungkham behlap hi; huchi in hon hehpih ding ka zong a, himahleh kuamah a-om kei ua; hon khamuan ding ka zong nawn a, kuamah ka mu sam kei.
Ka an ding in banghiam thil kha ahon piak behlap ua; ka dangtak in uain thuk dawn ding in hon pia uhi.
Ama ua adohkan uh thang hi henla; khamuangtak a a-om lai un pial suak hen.
Amitte uh, amuh theihlouhna ding un, hihmial in om hen; akawngbomte uh kivuangsak gige in.
Na lungkim louh mahmahna atung uah sungbua inla, na heh thangpaihna in amaute man hen.
A-omna uh gam henla; apuanin uah kuamah om kei hen.
Na satpa asawi ua, na sukliamte lungkhamna leng agen ngal nak uhi.
Athulimlouhna uah thulimlouhna behlap inla; amau na diktatna ah lut kei uhen.
Amin uh hinna bu a pan nulmang in om uhen, midiktat lak ah gelh hi kei uhen.
Himahleh kei gentheitak leh lungkhamtak ka hi a; Pathian aw, na hotdamna in mun sang ah hon koih in.
Pathian min la in ka phat ding a, kipahthu gen in amah ka pahtawi ding hi.
Huchibang in bawngtal hiam, kii leh chinnei bawngtal hiam, sang in TOUPA akipaksak zaw ding hi.
Thunuailutte'n huai mu in akipak uhi; nou Pathian zongte aw, na lungtang uh hing in om hen.
TOUPA'N tasamte ngaikhia in, ahentate amusit ngal kei a.
Lei leh van in amah phat hen, tuipite leh asung ua thil tang thei peuhmahte toh.
Pathian in Zion honkhia in, Judah khuate asiam dek ngal a; huchi in huai ah a-om ding ua, neih toh athuah ding uh.
Asikhate suante'n gou aluah ding ua; amin itte asung ah a-om ding uhi.
